<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#261329"><title>Tiny: Left Unsupervised | Stage 5: Baba Showdown</title>
<style>
:root{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#fff0dc;--gold:#ffe0a2;--rose:#df699c;--ink:#321936;--mint:#7de3c2;color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0810;touch-action:manipulation}body{display:grid;place-items:center}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;touch-action:manipulation}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #85fff3;outline-offset:3px}
#game{position:relative;width:min(100vw,217.25dvh);height:min(100dvh,46.03vw);aspect-ratio:2.1725;background:#251629;border:clamp(2px,.34vw,5px) solid #c99771;border-radius:clamp(10px,1.6vw,22px);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 40px #0009}
#game:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid #ffdca33c;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;z-index:50}
#hud{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:10.5%;background:linear-gradient(#211328ed,#2b1933e5);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5%;padding:0 1.1%;border-bottom:2px solid #f2c38e7a;z-index:25;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:900}
#brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ffd69c;font-size:clamp(10px,1.32vw,21px);margin-right:.8%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}#hud .pill{border:2px solid #b57c9c9e;background:#422642c9;border-radius:14px;padding:.23% .8%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.1vw,18px)}#energyLabel{font-size:clamp(9px,1.15vw,18px);margin-left:.55%}#energyGauge{flex:0 1 16%;height:20%;border:2px solid #b986ad;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;background:#150d1f;min-width:36px}#energyFill{height:100%;width:35%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d954a2,#ffe0bf);transition:width .2s}#hud .space{flex:1}.iconBtn{border:2px solid #8e7297;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;min-width:4.4%;height:78%;background:#4b2d55;font-size:clamp(14px,1.65vw,27px);padding:0 .25%}#hud .iconBtn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
#scene{position:absolute;top:10.5%;bottom:25.5%;left:0;right:0;background-image:linear-gradient(#190c2608,#220b2333),url(data:image/webp;base64,);background-position:center center;background-size:cover;overflow:hidden}
#nameplate{position:absolute;z-index:14;top:2.5%;left:1.3%;padding:.75% 1.7%;background:#26142fdf;border:2px solid #efc18e;border-radius:35px;color:#fff0d2;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(10px,1.35vw,22px);font-weight:bold;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #14091d}#roundLabel{position:absolute;top:3%;right:1.4%;background:#22182bdd;border:1px solid #ffe1aa;border-radius:35px;padding:.7% 1.5%;z-index:14;font-size:clamp(10px,1.2vw,18px);font-weight:900}
.fighter{position:absolute;bottom:-7%;height:101%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;z-index:5;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 11px #180b25b0);transition:filter .2s}#tiny{left:1.5%;width:26%;transform-origin:50% 93%;animation:breathe 3.3s ease-in-out infinite}#baba{right:1.5%;width:24%;height:94%;transform-origin:50% 93%;animation:breathe 4.2s ease-in-out infinite}#tiny.punch{animation:tinyPunch .52s ease-out!important}#tiny.dodge{animation:tinyDodge .65s ease-out!important}#tiny.sass{animation:tinySass .65s ease-out!important}#tiny.bonk{animation:tinyBonk .68s ease-in-out!important}#baba.flinch{animation:babaFlinch .62s ease-out!important}#baba.swing{animation:babaSwing .65s ease-out!important}#baba.sass{animation:babaSass .7s ease-in-out!important}
#tinyBonk{position:absolute;z-index:11;width:21%;height:94%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;left:1.5%;bottom:0%;display:none;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 7px #240d26)}#scene.hit #tiny{opacity:0}#scene.hit #tinyBonk{display:block;animation:tinyBonk .72s ease-out}
#speech{position:absolute;z-index:14;left:28%;top:14%;width:44%;min-height:27%;border:3px solid #5b315b;border-radius:20px;background:#fff9e9;color:#322237;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2%;text-align:center;padding:1.4% 2.1%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.36vw,20px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.21;overflow-wrap:anywhere;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #2b163eac;pointer-events:none}#speech strong{font-weight:950;color:#9a456e;font-size:.86em}#speech.hidden{display:none}
#fightCard{position:absolute;z-index:13;left:29%;top:24%;width:42%;height:52%;min-height:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:2%;justify-content:space-between;align-items:stretch;padding:1% 1.5%;border:3px solid #e9b873;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#2b193ef2,#48233ee8);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #170a24a6,0 0 18px #ffdebc2e;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}#fightCard.show{display:flex}
#fightHeader{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1em;color:#f8c88b;font-size:clamp(9px,1.04vw,16px);font-weight:900}#fightIcon{display:inline;font-size:clamp(17px,2.6vw,41px)}#fightTitle{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,27px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;color:#fff2e3;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #120d25}#fightHint{font-size:clamp(10px,1.18vw,18px);font-weight:850;color:#ffe8bb;line-height:1.12}#clockTrack{width:100%;height:12%;border:2px solid #dbac8d;border-radius:30px;background:#170d1c;overflow:hidden}#clockFill{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff68a6,#f5bd77,#a8f8c8);transform-origin:left center}#composure{position:absolute;z-index:10;left:29%;top:79%;width:42%;height:8%;display:none;align-items:center;gap:2%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.05vw,15px);background:#2b1639cf;border:1px solid #b98d96;border-radius:30px;padding:0 1%}#composure.show{display:flex}#composureTrack{flex:1;height:55%;border-radius:30px;background:#180d26;overflow:hidden}#composureFill{height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff7e9f,#f7c47c)}
#popFx{position:absolute;z-index:22;left:37%;top:36%;width:26%;font-size:clamp(25px,5vw,65px);font-weight:1000;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #48204b,0 5px 15px #000;background:transparent;pointer-events:none;display:none;animation:pop .65s ease-out}#popFx.show{display:block}#toast{position:absolute;z-index:23;top:4%;left:32%;width:36%;min-height:8%;background:#fce5b7;border:2px solid #794156;border-radius:12px;color:#532747;text-align:center;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 8px;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(9px,1.12vw,17px);pointer-events:none}#toast.show{display:flex}
#bottom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:25.5%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#211329,#321735);border-top:4px solid #e0af7e;display:grid;grid-template-columns:35% 65%;padding:.75% 1.2% 1%;gap:.5%;z-index:16}#copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-width:0;gap:1.4%}#kicker{font-size:clamp(9px,.93vw,14px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.65px;color:#f0a9c4;text-transform:uppercase}#speaker{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(16px,2.05vw,32px);line-height:1;color:#fbd09b;font-weight:900}#story{font-size:clamp(10px,1.15vw,17px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff3e6;max-height:3.6em;overflow:hidden}#actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1%;padding:0 1.2%;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{border:3px solid #ffe4b4;background:linear-gradient(#ffdda0,#d59a51);color:#44243e;border-radius:25px;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(10px,1.26vw,19px);padding:.9% 2.2%;min-height:45%;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #5b294dbf;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.15;max-width:100%;flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}.btn:nth-child(2),.btn:nth-child(3){background:linear-gradient(#f67db3,#b83e7e);color:white}.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.09)}.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #5b294d}.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(#fff0ad,#edb862);color:#4d2940}.btn.mini{font-size:clamp(9px,1.0vw,15px)}
#powerTray{position:absolute;z-index:32;top:12%;right:1%;max-width:36%;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:7px;background:#28162eef;border:2px solid #b88696;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0009}#powerTray.show{display:flex}#powerTray button{border:1px solid #f0c49a;border-radius:9px;background:#6c2e5e;color:#fff8e9;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(10px,1.0vw,15px);padding:6px 8px;white-space:normal}#powerTray button:disabled{opacity:.35}
#help,#pauseLayer{position:absolute;z-index:35;inset:11% 14% 26%;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4%;padding:3%;background:#24162af5;border:3px solid #d6ad79;border-radius:20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 16px 30px #000b}#help.show,#pauseLayer.show{display:flex}#help h2,#pauseLayer h2{font-size:clamp(17px,2.5vw,34px);color:#ffe2a4;margin:0}#help p,#pauseLayer p{font-size:clamp(11px,1.4vw,19px);line-height:1.25;margin:0}#help button,#pauseLayer button{width:65%;min-height:24%;max-height:40%}
#result{position:absolute;z-index:31;left:28%;top:18%;width:44%;height:66%;border:3px solid #f2c687;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(#27172cf4,#4b244bec);display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;text-align:center;gap:2%;padding:2%;box-shadow:0 10px 27px #140d21b0}#result.show{display:flex}#result h2{font-size:clamp(16px,2.25vw,36px);margin:0;color:#f8da98;font-family:Georgia,serif}#result p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.14vw,18px);margin:0;line-height:1.22}#result button{min-height:20%;width:90%;flex:none}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes tinyPunch{0%{transform:translate(0) scale(1)}25%{transform:translate(25%,0) scale(1.05) rotate(-7deg)}48%{transform:translate(47%,-5%) scale(1.12) rotate(7deg)}100%{transform:none}}
@keyframes tinyDodge{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}38%{transform:translateY(19%) scaleY(.82) rotate(-9deg)}66%{transform:translateY(17%) scaleY(.82)}}
@keyframes tinySass{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}40%{transform:rotate(-9deg) translateY(-3%)}70%{transform:rotate(8deg)}}
@keyframes tinyBonk{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0) scale(1)}22%{transform:rotate(-15deg) scale(1.09)}45%{transform:rotate(14deg) translateY(-6%)}65%{transform:rotate(-9deg)}}
@keyframes babaFlinch{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}30%{transform:translate(12%,2%) rotate(7deg)}58%{transform:translate(-4%,0) rotate(-4deg)}}
@keyframes babaSwing{0%,100%{transform:none}34%{transform:translate(-13%,0) rotate(-8deg)}60%{transform:translate(-19%,1%) rotate(6deg)}}
@keyframes babaSass{0%,100%{transform:none}40%{transform:translateY(-5%) rotate(6deg)}}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.2) rotate(-15deg);opacity:0}25%{transform:scale(1.3) rotate(7deg);opacity:1}68%{transform:scale(1) rotate(-5deg);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(.9) translateY(-14px);opacity:0}}
@media(max-width:850px){#hud{gap:.45%}#brand{font-size:clamp(9px,1.45vw,14px);margin-right:.2%}#hud .pill{font-size:10px}#energyLabel{font-size:10px}#energyGauge{flex-basis:9%}.iconBtn{border-radius:9px;font-size:17px;min-width:5.2%}#scene{background-position:center}#speech{top:13%;left:26%;width:48%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.4vw,14px);padding:1.5% 1.8%}#tiny{left:1%;width:26%}#baba{right:1%;width:23%}#fightCard{left:27%;width:46%;top:25%;height:49%;padding:1% 1.8%;border-width:2px}#composure{left:27%;width:46%;top:77%}#fightHint{font-size:10px}#fightTitle{font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,16px)}#bottom{grid-template-columns:37% 63%}#story{max-height:2.8em}#actions{gap:1%}.btn{font-size:11px;min-height:50%;border-width:2px;padding:1% 1.2%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#tiny,#baba,#tiny.punch,#tiny.dodge,#tiny.sass,#tiny.bonk,#baba.flinch,#baba.swing,#baba.sass,#popFx{animation:none!important}}
</style></head><body><main id="game" aria-label="Tiny Left Unsupervised Stage Five">
<header id="hud"><span id="brand">🎀 TINY LEFT UNSUPERVISED</span><span class="pill">STAGE 5</span><span class="pill">CHAOS <span id="score">0</span></span><span id="energyLabel">⚡ <span id="energy">35</span>/100</span><span id="energyGauge"><span id="energyFill" style="display:block"></span></span><span class="space"></span><button class="iconBtn" id="powerButton" aria-label="Chaos powers" title="Chaos powers">⚡</button><button class="iconBtn" id="helpButton" aria-label="Help" title="Help">?</button><button class="iconBtn" id="pauseButton" aria-label="Pause">Ⅱ</button><button class="iconBtn" id="soundButton" aria-label="Toggle sound">♫</button><button class="iconBtn" id="fullButton" aria-label="Fullscreen">⛶</button></header>
<section id="scene" aria-label="Royal boxing ring"><div id="nameplate">🥊 TINY VS. BABA</div><div id="roundLabel">ROUND <span id="roundNumber">0</span> / 10</div><img id="tiny" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Tiny in a black skirt and boots"><img id="tinyBonk" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Tiny dizzy after a cartoon bonk"><img id="baba" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Baba with glasses, beard and UTW hoodie"><div id="speech"><strong id="speechName">BABA</strong><span id="speechText">YOU DROVE MY TRAIN?! I am impressed, but now I challenge you!</span></div><div id="fightCard" aria-live="off"><div id="fightHeader"><span id="roundName">ROUND 1/10</span><span id="comboText">COMBO ×1</span></div><div id="fightIcon">👊</div><div id="fightTitle">BABA POSES FOR THE CAMERA</div><div id="fightHint">His guard is down! PUNCH!</div><div id="clockTrack"><span id="clockFill"></span></div></div><div id="composure"><span>🥊 BABA</span><span id="composureTrack"><span id="composureFill" style="display:block"></span></span><span id="composureValue">100%</span></div><div id="popFx" aria-hidden="true">POW!</div><div id="toast" role="status"></div></section>
<section id="bottom"><div id="copy"><div id="kicker">STAGE 5 • VERY UNNECESSARY DRAMA</div><div id="speaker">BABA</div><div id="story">YOU DROVE MY TRAIN?! I am impressed, but now I challenge you!</div></div><div id="actions"></div></section>
<div id="powerTray"><button id="puppy">🥺 PUPPY EYES · 30 ⚡</button><button id="raccoons">🦝 RACCOON ASSIST · 60 ⚡</button><button id="rage">🍗 NUGGIE RAGE · 100 ⚡</button></div>
<section id="help" role="dialog" aria-label="How to play"><h2>🥊 HOW TO BONK BABA</h2><p>Read Baba’s cue. Tap <b>PUNCH, DODGE, or SASS</b> before the countdown ends. For <b>COMBO</b> rounds, tap <b>DODGE → PUNCH</b> in that order. Incorrect moves cause silly bonks, not game over. ⚡ Opens your optional Chaos Powers.</p><button class="btn primary" id="closeHelp">GOT IT ✓</button></section>
<section id="pauseLayer" role="dialog" aria-label="Game paused"><h2>⏸ PAUSED</h2><p>Baba is being merciful. For now.</p><button class="btn primary" id="resumeBtn">RESUME ▸</button></section>
<section id="result" role="status"><h2 id="resultTitle">STAGE 5 COMPLETE</h2><p id="resultText"></p><button class="btn primary" id="replayBtn">REPLAY STAGE 5 ↻</button></section>
</main>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const intro=[['Baba','YOU DROVE MY TRAIN?! I am impressed, but now I challenge you!'],['Tiny','I am very small and very dangerous.'],['Baba','Exactly. You have three options: punch, dodge, or out-sass me.'],['Tiny','You forgot the fourth option. Raccoons.'],['Baba','...Actually, I respect that.']];
const moves=[
 {type:'punch',title:'BABA POSES FOR THE CAMERA',hint:'His guard is down! PUNCH!',say:'Baba: Go on, you can have the first one.'},
 {type:'dodge',title:'BABA WINDS UP A BONK!',hint:'DUCK THE INCOMING BONK. DODGE!',say:'Baba: I may have encouraged this.'},
 {type:'sass',title:'BABA STARTS A SPEECH',hint:'Interrupt the lecture. SASS!',say:'Baba: I think this is a valuable teaching moment.'},
 {type:'punch',title:'HE ADJUSTS HIS GLASSES',hint:'He cannot see! PUNCH!',say:'Tiny: Those glasses have a vulnerability.'},
 {type:'dodge',title:'BABA TELEGRAPHS A SWING',hint:'DODGE while he takes a big step!',say:'Baba: Observe my advanced technique.'},
 {type:'combo',title:'DODGE THEN PUNCH!',hint:'Two moves! DODGE → PUNCH!',say:'Devi: This is somehow more dangerous than the train.'},
 {type:'sass',title:'BABA TRIES TRASH TALK',hint:'Fight words with words. SASS!',say:'Baba: I bet you cannot even reach my glasses.'},
 {type:'dodge',title:'THE DOUBLE BONK WINDUP',hint:'Danger! DODGE!',say:'Mo: If you two break anything, it is corner time.'},
 {type:'combo',title:'HIS ULTIMATE COMBO',hint:'DODGE then PUNCH! Hurry!',say:'Savvy: *Aggressively sighs.*'},
 {type:'finish',title:'THE FINAL COMEBACK',hint:'Your choice! PUNCH, DODGE or SASS!',say:'Baba: Whatever you do, make it dramatic.'}
];
let g,deadline=0,total=0,pausedAt=0,runToken=0,interval=null,nextTimeout=null,fxTimeout=null,toastTimeout=null,canAudio=false,audioCtx=null,helpWasRunning=false;
function newState(){return {phase:'intro',introIdx:0,round:0,step:0,score:0,energy:35,wins:0,bonks:0,combos:0,streak:0,style:'punch',nuggie:0,paused:false,mood:'',outcome:''}}
function setActions(actions){const box=$('actions');box.replaceChildren();for(const [name,fn,cls=''] of actions){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn '+cls;b.textContent=name;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!g.paused){unlockSound();fn()}});box.append(b)}}
function setLine(name,words,kicker){$('speaker').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('story').textContent=words;if(kicker)$('kicker').textContent=kicker;$('speechName').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('speechText').textContent=words}
function speech(show){$('speech').classList.toggle('hidden',!show)}
function phase(p){g.phase=p;const active=p==='fight'||p==='react';$('fightCard').classList.toggle('show',active);$('composure').classList.toggle('show',active);speech(p==='intro'||p==='style'||p==='ready'||p==='verdict'||p==='ending'||p==='react');$('powerTray').classList.remove('show');$('result').classList.remove('show')}
function hud(){$('score').textContent=g.score.toLocaleString();$('energy').textContent=g.energy;$('energyFill').style.width=g.energy+'%';$('roundNumber').textContent=Math.min(g.round+1,10);const patience=clamp(100-g.wins*11+g.bonks*2,0,100);$('composureValue').textContent=patience+'%';$('composureFill').style.width=patience+'%';$('puppy').disabled=g.energy<30||g.phase!=='fight';$('raccoons').disabled=g.energy<60||g.phase!=='fight';$('rage').disabled=g.energy<100||g.phase!=='fight'}
function toast(msg,ms=1100){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimeout);toastTimeout=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),ms)}
function flash(msg,good=true){const el=$('popFx');el.textContent=msg;el.style.color=good?'#fff0ad':'#ffb3d4';el.classList.remove('show');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(fxTimeout);fxTimeout=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),730)}
function effect(correct,kind){const a=$('tiny'),b=$('baba'),s=$('scene');a.classList.remove('punch','dodge','sass','bonk');b.classList.remove('flinch','swing','sass');s.classList.remove('hit');void a.offsetWidth;if(correct){a.classList.add(kind==='dodge'?'dodge':kind==='sass'?'sass':'punch');b.classList.add(kind==='dodge'?'swing':kind==='sass'?'sass':'flinch');flash(kind==='sass'?'OH SNAP!':kind==='dodge'?'WHOOSH!':'POW!')}else{a.classList.add('bonk');b.classList.add('swing');s.classList.add('hit');flash('BONK!',false)}setTimeout(()=>{s.classList.remove('hit');a.classList.remove('punch','dodge','sass','bonk');b.classList.remove('flinch','swing','sass')},700)}
function sound(freq=520,length=.09,type='sine'){if(!canAudio)return;try{audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();let o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),v=audioCtx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;v.gain.setValueAtTime(.035,audioCtx.currentTime);v.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audioCtx.currentTime+length);o.connect(v).connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+length)}catch{}}
function unlockSound(){if(audioCtx&&audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{})}
function init(){clearInterval(interval);clearTimeout(nextTimeout);clearTimeout(fxTimeout);clearTimeout(toastTimeout);g=newState();if(Number.isFinite(window.__tinyInheritedEnergy))g.energy=window.__tinyInheritedEnergy;runToken++;$('tiny').src='data:image/webp;base64,';$('scene').classList.remove('hit');$('tiny').className='fighter';$('baba').className='fighter';$('popFx').classList.remove('show');$('toast').classList.remove('show');$('help').classList.remove('show');$('pauseLayer').classList.remove('show');$('result').classList.remove('show');$('powerTray').classList.remove('show');$('pauseButton').textContent='Ⅱ';helpWasRunning=false;hud();showIntro()}
function showIntro(){phase('intro');const [name,line]=intro[g.introIdx];setLine(name,line,'THE CHALLENGE • '+(g.introIdx+1)+' / '+intro.length);setActions([[g.introIdx===intro.length-1?'CHOOSE A FIGHTING STYLE ▸':'NEXT ▸',()=>{g.introIdx++;if(g.introIdx>=intro.length)styleSelect();else showIntro()},'primary']]);hud()}
function styleSelect(){phase('style');setLine('Baba','Come on, show me that Tiny energy! Choose your style. You can still use all three moves in the ring.','OFFICIAL UTW SPARRING RULES');setActions([['👊 CHAOTIC PUNCHES',()=>setStyle('punch')],['🌀 SNEAKY DODGES',()=>setStyle('dodge')],['💬 MAXIMUM SASS',()=>setStyle('sass')]]);hud()}
function setStyle(style){g.style=style;phase('ready');setLine('Baba',style==='sass'?'That is my girl. A menace with vocabulary.':style==='dodge'?'I can already hear the footwork.':'Bold choice, Tiny. Absolutely spectacular.','BABA’S TECHNIQUE: ENCOURAGEMENT');setActions([['START THE SHOWDOWN ▸',()=>startBeat(0),'primary']]);hud()}
function stopTimer(){clearInterval(interval);interval=null}
function startBeat(index){stopTimer();clearTimeout(nextTimeout);if(index>=moves.length){verdict();return}g.phase='fight';g.round=index;g.step=0;g.paused=false;const m=moves[index];phase('fight');const duration=Math.max(1.95,3.8-index*.2)*1000;deadline=performance.now()+duration;total=duration;runToken++;const token=runToken;
 $('roundName').textContent='🥊 ROUND '+(index+1)+' / 10';$('comboText').textContent='COMBO ×'+(g.streak+1);$('fightIcon').textContent=m.type==='punch'?'👊':m.type==='dodge'?'🌀':m.type==='sass'?'💬':m.type==='combo'?'⚡':'🏆';$('fightTitle').textContent=m.title;$('fightHint').textContent=m.hint;$('clockFill').style.width='100%';setLine(m.say.split(':')[0],m.say.slice(m.say.indexOf(':')+1).trim(),'TINY VS BABA • '+(index+1)+' / 10');setActions([['👊 PUNCH',()=>fightAction('punch'),'primary'],['🌀 DODGE',()=>fightAction('dodge')],['💬 SASS',()=>fightAction('sass')]]);hud();
 interval=setInterval(()=>{if(g.phase!=='fight'||token!==runToken){stopTimer();return}if(g.paused)return;const time=deadline-performance.now();$('clockFill').style.width=clamp(time/total*100,0,100)+'%';if(time<=0)resolve(false,'timeout')},33)}
function fightAction(kind){if(g.phase!=='fight'||g.paused)return;const m=moves[g.round];if(m.type==='combo'){const expected=g.step===0?'dodge':'punch';if(kind!==expected){resolve(false,kind);return}if(g.step===0){g.step=1;deadline+=1550;total+=1550;$('fightIcon').textContent='👊';$('fightTitle').textContent='NICE DUCK! NOW PUNCH!';$('fightHint').textContent='SECOND MOVE: 👊 PUNCH!';setLine('Tiny','I AM BOTH FAST AND SHORT.');effect(true,'dodge');sound(640,.07);return}g.combos++;resolve(true,kind);return}
 resolve(m.type==='finish'||kind===m.type,kind)}
function resolve(correct,kind,byPower=false){if(g.phase!=='fight')return;stopTimer();g.phase='react';const index=g.round;const token=runToken;speech(true);effect(correct,kind);const m=moves[index];let points=0;if(correct){g.wins++;g.streak++;points=180+Math.min(4,g.streak-1)*55+(m.type==='combo'?150:0)+(m.type==='finish'?200:0)+(kind===g.style?60:0);if(g.nuggie>0){points*=2;g.nuggie--}g.score+=points;g.energy=clamp(g.energy+12,0,100);if(g.streak>=3&&g.streak%3===0){g.score+=125;toast('🔥 3-MOVE COMBO! +125',780)}else toast('+'+points+' CHAOS!',680);sound(kind==='dodge'?560:kind==='sass'?760:640,.13,'triangle')}
 else{g.bonks++;g.streak=0;toast('💫 SILLY BONK! KEEP GOING!',800);sound(165,.19,'sawtooth')}
 $('fightTitle').textContent=correct?(kind==='sass'?'BABA HAS BEEN OUT-SASSED':kind==='dodge'?'PERFECT LITTLE DUCK!':'TINY LANDS A CARTOON BONK!'):'WHOOPS! BABA GETS A BONK IN!';$('fightHint').textContent=correct?(byPower?'RACCOON ARMY SAVES THE ROUND!':'NEXT ROUND INCOMING…'):'NO GAME OVER. JUST EVIDENCE.';$('fightIcon').textContent=correct?'✨':'💫';$('clockFill').style.width='0%';const roasts=[['Nice lecture. Does it come with a skip button?','I spent all morning rehearsing that.'],['Your train had better brakes than your comeback.','I shall file a highly specific complaint.'],['Baba, that was your big threat? My water bottle has more range.','I regret teaching you vocabulary.'],['I am the personality hire. You are the HR incident.','Mo is going to make us both attend training.'],['I brought snacks, audacity, and absolutely no adult supervision.','There is simply no defense against this strategy.']];
  if(correct&&kind==='sass'){
    const roast=roasts[index%roasts.length];setLine('Tiny',roast[0],'💬 TINY DELIVERS MAXIMUM SASS • ROUND '+(index+1));
    setTimeout(()=>{if(token===runToken&&g.phase==='react')setLine('Baba',roast[1],'💬 BABA ATTEMPTS A COMEBACK')},1250);
  }else if(correct){
    const tinyLines=['That was a professional bonk. Invoice incoming.','I AM SHORT, NOT HARMLESS.','I hope this is covered by alliance insurance.','Baba, I came here to win and eat nuggets.','Noosh specifically asked me not to do this.'];
    setLine(index%2?'Baba':'Tiny',index%2?'I encouraged this, did I not?':tinyLines[index%tinyLines.length],'🥊 TINY VS BABA • ROUND '+(index+1));
  }else{
    setLine(index%2?'Mo':'Tiny',kind==='sass'?'MY INSULT TRIPPED OVER ITS OWN SHOELACES.':index%2?'Both of you, the corner.':'I MEANT TO DO THAT. IT WAS PERFORMANCE ART.','🥊 TINY VS BABA • ROUND '+(index+1));
  }hud();
 const advance=()=>{if(token!==runToken||g.phase!=='react')return;if(g.paused){nextTimeout=setTimeout(advance,80);return}startBeat(index+1)};nextTimeout=setTimeout(advance,correct&&kind==='sass'?3100:2000)}
function verdict(){stopTimer();phase('verdict');g.outcome=g.wins>=8?'tiny-champion':g.wins>=5?'friendly-draw':'baba-victory';if(g.outcome==='tiny-champion'){g.score+=400;setLine('Baba','I have been defeated by someone approximately the size of my shoe. BRAVO.')}else if(g.outcome==='friendly-draw'){g.score+=180;setLine('Baba','This was technically a draw. I would like that noted in writing.')}else setLine('Baba','I win! Tiny wins in spirit. Mo says we both lose.');$('roundNumber').textContent=10;hud();$('kicker').textContent='STAGE 5 • UNOFFICIAL VERDICT';setActions([['ACCEPT THE VERY QUESTIONABLE RESULT ▸',finish,'primary']])}
function finish(){phase('ending');setLine('Noosh','I WAS GONE FOR FIVE MINUTES. Why does the station have a boxing ring?!','NEXT STAGE • THE ULTIMATE COVER-UP');setActions([['VIEW INCIDENT REPORT ▸',report,'primary']])}
function report(){phase('ending');$('resultTitle').textContent=g.outcome==='tiny-champion'?'🏆 TINY-SIZED CHAMPION!':g.outcome==='friendly-draw'?'🤝 OFFICIALLY A DRAW':'🥊 BABA WINS THE ROUND';$('resultText').textContent=''+g.score.toLocaleString()+' CHAOS POINTS · '+g.wins+'/10 SUCCESSFUL MOVES · '+g.bonks+' CARTOON BONKS · '+g.combos+' COMPLETED COMBOS. Savvy has resigned as referee. NEXT: THE ULTIMATE COVER-UP.';$('result').classList.add('show');speech(false);setActions([]);let b=$('tinyContinueBtn');if(!b){b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn primary';b.id='tinyContinueBtn';$('result').appendChild(b)}b.textContent='CONTINUE TO STAGE 6 ▸';b.onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:5,score:g.score,energy:g.energy,meta:{wins:g.wins,bonks:g.bonks,combos:g.combos,outcome:g.outcome,style:g.style}},'*');hud()}
function togglePause(){if(g.phase!=='fight'&&g.phase!=='react'||$('help').classList.contains('show'))return;if(g.paused){g.paused=false;if(g.phase==='fight')deadline+=performance.now()-pausedAt;$('pauseLayer').classList.remove('show');$('pauseButton').textContent='Ⅱ'}else{g.paused=true;pausedAt=performance.now();$('pauseLayer').classList.add('show');$('pauseButton').textContent='▶'}}
function power(kind){if(g.phase!=='fight'||g.paused)return;const cost={puppy:30,raccoons:60,rage:100}[kind];if(g.energy<cost)return;g.energy-=cost;$('powerTray').classList.remove('show');if(kind==='puppy'){deadline+=2000;total+=2000;toast('🥺 BABA GRANTS 2 EXTRA SECONDS!',1000);sound(590)}else if(kind==='raccoons'){resolve(true,'raccoon',true);toast('🦝 RACCOONS INTERVENE!',800)}else{g.nuggie=3;toast('🍗 NEXT THREE HITS EARN DOUBLE!',900);sound(900)}hud()}
$('helpButton').onclick=()=>{if($('help').classList.contains('show'))return;helpWasRunning=(g.phase==='fight'||g.phase==='react')&&!g.paused;if(helpWasRunning){g.paused=true;pausedAt=performance.now()}$('help').classList.add('show')};$('closeHelp').onclick=()=>{$('help').classList.remove('show');if(helpWasRunning){g.paused=false;if(g.phase==='fight')deadline+=performance.now()-pausedAt}helpWasRunning=false};$('pauseButton').onclick=togglePause;$('resumeBtn').onclick=togglePause;$('powerButton').onclick=()=>{$('powerTray').classList.toggle('show')};$('puppy').onclick=()=>power('puppy');$('raccoons').onclick=()=>power('raccoons');$('rage').onclick=()=>power('rage');$('replayBtn').onclick=init;$('soundButton').onclick=()=>{canAudio=!canAudio;$('soundButton').textContent=canAudio?'♫':'♪';if(canAudio){unlockSound();sound(650)}};$('fullButton').onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*');
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){if($('help').classList.contains('show')){$('closeHelp').click()}else if(g.paused)togglePause();return}if(g.phase==='fight'){const key={'1':'punch','ArrowLeft':'punch','2':'dodge','ArrowDown':'dodge','3':'sass','ArrowRight':'sass'}[e.key];if(key){e.preventDefault();fightAction(key)}}});
init();
})();
</script></body></html>
